basics.label: Senior Implementation Consultant | Enterprise Delivery | Client Onboarding | Change Management
basics.summary: Implementation and operations leader with 12+ years across U.S. healthcare delivery, client onboarding, business analysis, process transformation, analytics, and founder-led service operations. Converts ambiguous customer requirements into executable plans, governance routines, risk controls, training, and measurable handoffs. Coordinates cross-functional stakeholders, manages high-volume operations, and builds automation and reporting systems that improve delivery visibility and accountability.
